description: The workbook describes 21 Brampton stormwater ponds, including pond area and surrounding impermeable cover. This resource is provided by Gab Izma. Coverage is city as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists XLSX formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: These study-site characteristics need the accompanying observation records for water-quality calibration. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epa-swmm. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
name: Stormwater pond site features
